item.title: Colombia Military Says 80 Troops Believed Dead In Plane Crash
item.description: Report says that A military transport plane crashed when taking off in Colombia, with at least 80 people aboard though there were conflicting reports about how many troops were dead and injured.

item.title: Osimhen Undergoes Successful Surgery After Arm Fracture
item.description: Report says that Galatasaray have confirmed that Victor Osimhen has undergone a successful surgery on a fractured right forearm sustained during their 4–0 defeat to Liverpool in the UEFA Champions League Round of 16 second leg

item.title: UK Returnee Dies In Lagos-Ibadan Expressway Crash
item.description: We have news that a woman who had just returned from the United Kingdom to attend a wedding in Abeokuta, Ogun State, has died in a road crash along the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway.

item.title: Ondo Police Arrest Two, Recover Stolen Cars
item.description: The Ondo State Police Command has arrested two suspects and recovered a stolen Toyota Camry in Akure, Ondo State.

item.title: El-Rufai Arrives Kaduna Court Under Heavy Security
item.description: Former Kaduna State Governor, Nasir El-Rufai, has arrived at the Federal High Court in Kaduna State, under tight security for his arraignment over alleged corruption-related offences.

item.title: Nine-year-old Girl Dies In Truck Accident
item.description: A nine-year-old girl has died following a truck crash that occurred at Akungba-Akoko, Akoko South-West Local Government Area of Ondo State.

item.title: Atiku Denies Quitting Politics, Warns Against Disinformation
item.description: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, has raised alarm over what he described as efforts by some anti-democratic persons to create confusion and slow down the growing momentum of the African Democratic Congress, ADC.

item.title: Plateau Govt Imposes 48‑Hour Curfew After Deadly Attack on Jos
item.description: The Plateau State Government has imposed a 48‑hour curfew on Jos North Local Government Area following a deadly attack on Sunday.

item.title: Kwankwaso’s Defection To ADC: APC, Threat To Democracy
item.description: The National Chairman of African Democratic Congress, David Mark, has said that the All Progressive Congress, represented the most dangerous threat to multiparty democracy in the country.

item.title: US Lawmaker Warns Over Plateau, Kaduna Killings
item.description: United States congressman, Riley Moore, has warned that the continued attacks on Christians in Nigeria could strain diplomatic relations with the Unted States, following reports of a deadly Palm Sunday killings in Jos, Plateau State, and Kaduna State.

item.title: Super Eagles Hit by Four Withdrawals, Left With 21 Players Ahead of Clash with Jordan
item.description: Report says that Nigeria’s national team, the Super Eagles, have suffered setback ahead of their international friendly against Jordan, with 21 players available in the squad for this Tuesday’s encounter against Jordan.

item.title: Anambra Police Command Undertakes Walkathon In Commemoration Of National Police Day
item.description: The Anambra State Police Command has undertaken a walkathon to promote physical fitness and strengthen police-community relations as part of activities marking the 2026 National Police Day celebration.

item.title: NEMA Distributes Relief Materials To C’River Fire Victims
item.description: The National Emergency Management Agency, NEMA, has commenced the distribution of relief materials to persons and communities affected by recent fire disasters in parts of Cross River State.

item.title: Mutfwang Says 28 Killed In Jos Attack, Vows Action
item.description: The Governor of Plateau State, Caleb Mutfwang, has confirmed that 28 people were killed during Sunday’s attack by gunmen in the Angwan Rukuba community, Jos North Local Government Area.

item.title: ‎Obi Seeks Opposition Alliance To Tackle Nation’s Challenges
item.description: Former presidential candidate, Peter Obi, has expressed concern over the worsening insecurity in Nigeria, calling for stronger unity among opposition figures to tackle the nation’s challenges.
